title: Design System: Field Atlas Decision Desk

body.purpose: Form labels, explanations, evidence prose, and controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:42px;padding:9px 16px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:#A8D53F;color:#18211B;font:700 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif;transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#C0EB4F}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.975)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #244632;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet paper action for secondary operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{min-height:42px;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(61,91,67,.17);border-radius:14px;background:#FFFEFA;color:#244632;font:680 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:#F0F3EA}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #244632;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A paper control with a complete-control focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;color:#657166;font:600 13px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif}.ds-field input{height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:0;border-radius:13px;background:#FFFEFA;color:#18211B;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(27,47,32,.045);font:400 15px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif}.ds-field input:focus{outline:0;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(27,47,32,.045),0 0 0 3px rgba(168,213,63,.32)}

components.name: Metric Module
components.description: A soft status module; the priority variant uses deep field green.
components.css: .ds-metric{min-width:180px;padding:18px;border-radius:20px;background:#F7F6F1;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(27,47,32,.065);color:#18211B}.ds-metric span{display:block;color:#657166;font:680 12px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif}.ds-metric strong{display:block;margin-top:8px;font:730 19px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif}

components.name: Scope Chip
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:30px;padding:4px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(55,84,61,.14);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(247,246,241,.76);color:#244632;font:680 12px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif}

components.name: Image Hero
components.description: The overview chapter opener with field photography and one next action.
components.html:
从一块田开始

建立可追溯的风险判断
components.css: .ds-hero{min-height:360px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:36px;border-radius:30px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,42,28,.9),rgba(20,42,28,.2)),#5f7755;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(27,47,32,.09)}.ds-hero b{font:720 34px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif}.ds-hero p{margin:8px 0 24px;font:400 15px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Microsoft YaHei UI',sans-serif}.ds-hero button{padding:9px 16px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:#A8D53F;color:#18211B;font-weight:700}

narrative.overview: The interface treats each assessment as a route through a working field atlas. Large agricultural imagery establishes the operating context, while pale survey-like surfaces hold exact inputs, evidence states, and intervention boundaries.
keyCharacteristics: Pale mineral canvas with warm paper-like modules.
Electric lime reserved for selection and the next action.
Agricultural photography explicitly labeled as atmosphere.
Dense evidence presented with calm spacing and visible boundaries.

rules.name: The One Route Rule
rules.body: Lime carries selection and the recommended next action; it is not scattered decoration.

dos: Do use Signal Lime for the current route and primary actions.
Do label atmosphere photography as non-measurement material.
Do keep missing values and evidence boundaries adjacent to results.
donts: Don't return to a dark sidebar or generic Streamlit default surface.
Don't use lime as decoration on inactive objects.
Don't let agricultural imagery imply local observation or forecast data.
